overview.value: After his teammates leave, amateur Blader Robin Kazami has no choice but to join the mysterious Blader X.
After revealing his true identity and forming Team Persona with Robin, Jaxon signs the new team up for a pro-selection match.
After their battle with the mega-popular Multi Nana-iro, Jaxon set his sights on a potential third member for Team Persona.
Now that they're officially pros, the hunt is on for Team Persona's Bey Sponsor, who will help them train and climb The X.
Now that Team Persona is officially sponsored by Komaba Sushi, the team is finally ready to battle at The X.
Instead of training, Robin, Jaxon, and Multi set off to Lion's Jungle to scout out their opponents, Team Zooganic, and see if they could gather any intel.
It's Team Persona's debut match, and they're set to go head-to-head with the inimitable Team Zooganic.

title.value: Il ragazzo mascherato e il re della giungla

overview.value: The Persona-Zooganic showdown is locked at one point each. It has all come down to Jaxon's battle with Zooganic's leader, Titus Manju.
After their victory against Team Zooganic, Multi uses some Beycrafting skills to help Robin improve his game.
Team Phalanx is hanging on to their sponsorship by a thread. Their upcoming match with Team Persona is their last chance to stay in the limelight.
After failing Warden's Exam, Robin wonders if he can ever get to the same level as his teammates.
Team Persona enters the Solo Battle Fest, a series of exhibition matches.
With all eyes on Blader X and Multi Nana-iro, Robin finds his first fan.
Ms. Myoden informs everyone that a new Blader has broken Jaxon's record.
At Zonamos House Bladers can not only battle but also solve riddles
Team Persona have just one riddle left to solve!
A mysterious Bey has been distributed all over the city.
After switching their Beys, Team Phalanx is on a winning streak.
Team Persona is a guest at Zip and Zoom.
Team Persona have to raise Robin's popularity with fans.
Multi helps Jaxon and Robin up their fashion game.
Team Persona’s match against Yggdrasil is here!
Blaze is nowhere to be seen at the second battle of the Persona-Yggdrasil match.
Blaze Fujiwara finally arrives at the match.
The battle to determine the team's results for the Persona-Yggdrasil match has begun.
The Shuffle Battle Fest, an event where B4 breaks existing teams apart and creates a new group of teams, will be held.
Takumi is holding Bey battles against multiple amateurs for some reason.
The Shuffle Battle Fest has finally begun! In this event, previously unimagined teams clashed from the very first match.

title.value: Tra maschere e panini al vapore

overview.value: The Battle between Blader X and Jian begins. Titus tells Mr. Taisho how he met the Zooganic members and what makes them strong.
The Shuffle Battle Fest continues, and Multi's team, Multi and Me, goes up against Top Boyz.
The match between Team Multi and Me and Team Top Boyz enters its final battle.
The last day of the Shuffle Battle Fest has arrived, and Robin's team, Found Family, is ready for battle.
It's the Found Family's final battle and time for Meiko Myoden to take the stage.
Jaxon and Robin are helping out at Komaba Sushi when Sigrid Nana-iro comes looking for something to eat.
Now that the Shuffle Battle Fest voting polls have closed, the All-Star Battle is set to begin!
Robin loses in the All-Star to Packu, Multi picks up where he left off.
The second Blader for the dreams is the unpredictable Rex Jura.
It's time for the living legend, Quinn Manju, to take the stage.
The final clash of the All-Star Battle is underway.
Someone calling themselves Blader Y appears in Xenon City, battling Pro Bladers.
Blader Y’s not the only masked stranger hunting pros.
It’s up to Robin to come up with a plot to lure out these troublesome masked Bladers.

title.value: Team Pendragon: un tuffo nel passato

overview.value: This is a story of how Team Pendragon used to be.
Multi tells Robin about the history of his Bey, Scythe Incendio.
A young Blader arrives in Xenon City, full of dreams.
Robin heads back to his hometown with Jaxon before the title match.
At last, it’s Team Persona’s battle against Team Pendragon.

title.value: Le sorelle Nana-iro alla resa dei conti

overview.value: Multi goes up against Sigrid Nana-iro in the first battle of the title match.
Pendragon’s second Blader is Khrome Ryugu; it's Blader X's turn to take the stage.
After a head-on collision cracks Buster Dran, Khrome reflects on his time with Jaxon.
In the final battle, Blader Z seeks revenge while Robin is cheered on by his teammates.
They might have lost, but Team Persona still has their sights set on the top of The X.
Zooganic and Yggdrasil are likely candidates to be contenders in the next Title Match.
With Khrome missing, Team Pendragon is not allowed to battle in an official match.
Takumi's visit to Yggdrasil Research is interrupted by Karla Konjiki.
Tenka Shiroboshi appears at Komaba Sushi, demanding a battle with Blader X.
Finally, Team Persona's next match has been set against not one but two teams!
When Zonamos passes on an opportunity to pose a riddle, Multi knows something is up!
With Blader X indisposed, a new Blader helps Team Persona: the mysterious Blader S!
Blaze, Zonamos, and Yuni go to a remote Yggdrasil Research lab when a guest arrives!
At last, Blader X takes on Tenka.
Multi visits the prestigious Bey academy to ask an old mentor for help.
On the quest to learn more about Beycrafting, Multi visits the home of the Manju Clan.
While chatting with Joka, Multi expresses feelings of anxiety towards this ‘new era’.
When Tenka asks Robin what made him start Blading, he reminisces about his old friend.
Robin wants to give Tsubasa advice, but he needs to prove his strength as a Blader.
Packun shares a rumour that could upend the Blading world!
Ginro invites Jaxon to join the fight to save the world from the Shadow Pros.
Ginro and the others try to rescue Packun from the Shadow Pros.
Byte appears and tempts Ciel with the power of the ‘Dread Dragon’.
Khrome has been missing but now he’s come face to face with Omega Shiroboshi.

title.value: Il labirinto degli indovinelli e del terrore

overview.value: Zonamos House hosts an event where fans get to battle Blader X…if they can solve riddles!
The Star Battle begins: Pro and Amateur Bladers launch into battle.
When Persona meets with Gordias, their first battle is between each team's leader.
Multi completes an epic Beycrafting journey and returns to Team Persona with a new Bey!
Team Persona's first showdown of the Star Battle is coming to an end.
Jaxon reunites with Khrome somewhere in the depths of Xenon City.
Quinn sends Toguro and Jian to visit the Manju clan so they can learn about customisation.
Packun convinces Quinn and Rex to rejoin the Dreams and enter the Star Battle.
Blaze Fujiwara hosts Takumi Ishiyama on a talkshow to discuss Blading.
Persona's new Beys are complete but not just any opponent will do for their unveiling!
After their defeat, the two remaining members of Team Pendragon are in shock.
Robin is worried he can't unleash the powers of his new Bey, Reaper Incendio.
The curtain rises on a battle, not between Bladers, but between Beycrafters!
As Yggdrasil climbs to the top of the Star Battle rankings, they're challenged by Gordias.
The Battle between Gordias and Yggdrasil enters its third set.
While searching alone for a powerful opponent, Khrome stumbles upon Byte.
Sigrid learns about Ciel's 'mentor' and visits him in the hopes of becoming stronger.
Ginro tells Ciel that Khrome has become a Shadow Pro under the name of Blader Y.
Yoko Kyubi, the leader of the Unknowns, visits Packun after seeing his latest copy Bey.
The Unknowns and the Dreams clash.
Lantz Roji from Team Zodiac suddenly appears at Komaba Sushi.
Frustrated after his Battle against Lantz, Robin concentrates on training.
Blader X and Ryu Isshin face off.
Yoko demands a third round of the Super Champion Challenger Chooser.
A young Tenka trains with her fellow students and looks up to her mother, Omega.
The day of the Star Battle grand final is here at last and the crowd can't wait.
Next is the fated showdown between Robin Kazami and Lantz Roji!
With her teammates' support, Tenka challenges Omega.
Tenka lost to Omega. Who will face off against the Team Zodiac leader now?
At a fan event, Jaxon defeats countless Bladers until one forces a draw.
If the Cross family isn't defeated, Xenon City will face annihilation.
Nine warns the team that Multi's Beys won't be enough to defeat the Cross family.
Late at night, Three and Four Cross challenge Ginro to a battle.
While Pro Bladers expect a showdown with the Cross family, Team Persona receive a message.
Blader X takes on Three and Four Cross in the hopes of stopping the Cross family.
Tempted by Zero Cross's theories, Blaze accepts a battle with One.
Packun livestreams himself sneaking into the True X alone.
In the True X, One Cross invites Khrome Ryugu to participate in an experiment.
While Sigrid and Ciel ask Multi for help, Titus Manju calls on every Pro Blader for aid.
Blading fans watch the fierce showdown between Pro Bladers and the Cross family.
Five Cross shows up at Komaba Sushi to demand a battle with Jaxon.
When Blaze goes missing, Yuni and Zonamos run to Team Persona for help.
Aiming to understand Zero Cross's tactics, Persona use the stadiums he set up around town.
Executive Director Gigatani wants Sigrid and Ciel to transfer to the True X as champions.
A series of masked Bladers are dispatched across Xenon City by Zero Cross.
As Zero Cross's master plan proceeds, Gigatani joins his own ambitions to the True X.
Byte gives Robin and Jaxon a message from Khrome that stops Jaxon in his tracks.
Persona is preparing to face the Cross family, but Jaxon’s only thinking about Khrome.
Team Persona distract the Cross siblings to give Jaxon the chance to find Khrome.
